usedFor: touchSMS receives texts, and HubSpot logs the sender through “Create Contact” after “New SMS Received”.

bestTemplate.name: “New SMS Received” in touchSMS, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Sender, text and time reach HubSpot, so an inbound text starts a record.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, so a text alone is not enough to run it.
